run_gemini_robotics_policy_eval: run the Gemini Robotics policy evaluation loop on an Aloha dual-arm robot with camera and joint observations
build_timestep_spec: build a TimeStepSpec defining image, joint position, and instruction observation specs for the Aloha robot
create_image_controller: create an ImageController that subscribes to ROS compressed image topics and stores the latest frames per camera
create_key_detect: create a KeyDetect context manager that listens for non-blocking key presses in a background thread
create_sigint_handler: create a SigintHandler that registers a custom SIGINT signal handler and restores the previous handler on cleanup
